name: Gemini Developer API
summary: Google's API for Gemini models, multimodal generation, structured output, and tool calling.
avoid_when: the project does not benefit from generative AI
you cannot tolerate free-tier capacity limits
cost_note: A free developer tier exists for supported models. Model and tool quotas vary, so verify the pricing and rate-limit pages.

name: Google AI Studio
summary: Browser workspace for trying Gemini models, prompts, tools, and obtaining a Gemini API key.
avoid_when: you need the final experience embedded in your own application
cost_note: Interactive use and free-tier API access are available, subject to product and model limits.

name: Firebase Authentication
summary: Managed user authentication with client SDKs and common identity providers.
avoid_when: you need complex enterprise authorization
you plan heavy phone-number authentication without checking pricing
cost_note: Common authentication methods are suitable for small prototypes; phone authentication and Identity Platform features can have separate pricing.

name: Cloud Firestore
summary: Managed document database with Firebase client SDKs and realtime listeners.
avoid_when: you require complex relational joins
you have not designed security rules
cost_note: Firestore provides a no-cost quota appropriate for many prototypes; usage beyond the quota is billed.

name: Firebase Realtime Database
summary: Cloud-hosted JSON database that synchronizes changes to connected clients.
avoid_when: your data has complex query or relational requirements
cost_note: The Firebase Spark plan includes limited database storage and transfer for prototypes.

name: Firebase Hosting
summary: Fast hosting and deployment for static sites and single-page web applications.
avoid_when: your application requires a long-running custom server
cost_note: The Spark plan includes limited hosting storage and data transfer suitable for small demos.

name: Firebase App Hosting
summary: Managed deployment for supported full-stack web frameworks with Google Cloud infrastructure.
avoid_when: students cannot enable billing
a static Firebase Hosting deployment is sufficient
cost_note: App Hosting requires the Firebase Blaze pay-as-you-go plan even when underlying services have no-cost allowances.

name: Firebase AI Logic
summary: Firebase SDKs for calling Gemini models from web and mobile applications with application protections.
best_for: Gemini features in a client app
avoid_when: a simple trusted backend call is easier
you have not configured App Check and API restrictions
cost_note: Can use Gemini Developer API free-tier models; model quotas and Firebase service limits still apply.

name: Genkit
summary: Open-source framework for building, testing, and observing AI-powered application flows.
avoid_when: a beginner workshop benefits from showing the underlying function calls directly
cost_note: The framework is open source; connected model and hosting services have their own pricing.

name: Google Cloud Run
summary: Managed service for deploying containerized web applications and APIs.
avoid_when: students cannot enable a Cloud billing account
the team has no Docker experience and a simpler host works
cost_note: Cloud Run has a recurring no-cost usage allowance, but a Google Cloud billing account is normally required.

name: BigQuery Sandbox
summary: No-cost way to explore BigQuery and query public datasets without a billing account.
avoid_when: you need a transactional application database
sandbox expiration limits do not fit the project
cost_note: The sandbox works without a credit card but has storage, processing, and expiration limitations.

name: Google Colab
summary: Hosted Jupyter notebook environment for Python experiments and shareable demonstrations.
avoid_when: you need an always-on production backend
the demo requires guaranteed accelerators
cost_note: A free runtime is available, but resources, accelerator access, and session duration are not guaranteed.

name: MediaPipe Solutions
summary: Cross-platform libraries and pretrained tasks for vision, text, and audio processing.
avoid_when: you need a highly specialized model not covered by a packaged task
cost_note: MediaPipe libraries and packaged models can run locally without per-request API charges.

name: Google ML Kit
summary: Mobile SDKs for common machine-learning tasks such as text recognition and barcode scanning.
avoid_when: the project is web-only
you require unsupported custom model behavior
cost_note: Many on-device APIs are available without per-request charges; cloud-backed features can differ.

name: TensorFlow.js
summary: JavaScript library for running and training machine-learning models in browsers or Node.js.
avoid_when: a hosted API would be much simpler
the model is too large for student devices
cost_note: Open-source library with no API charge; computation runs on your own device or infrastructure.

name: Teachable Machine
summary: Browser tool for training simple image, sound, and pose models without writing training code.
avoid_when: you need production-grade accuracy
the problem requires large or sensitive datasets
cost_note: The browser tool is free to use; exported models can run locally.

name: Gemma
summary: Google's family of open models that can be run or adapted on compatible local and hosted hardware.
avoid_when: student hardware cannot run the selected model
a hosted Gemini API call is simpler
cost_note: Model access is free under its license; running it may require your own compute.

name: Google Maps Platform
summary: APIs and SDKs for interactive maps, places, geocoding, and routes.
avoid_when: students cannot enable billing
a basic open map is sufficient
cost_note: Individual APIs have monthly no-cost usage caps, but a billing-enabled project is generally required.

name: Google Sheets API
summary: Read and update Google spreadsheets from an application.
avoid_when: the application needs transactional guarantees
OAuth setup would slow down the workshop
cost_note: The API has request quotas and no additional API charge at ordinary workshop scale; authentication is still required.

name: Google Drive API
summary: Programmatic access to files and folders stored in Google Drive.
avoid_when: you want zero OAuth setup
the application needs anonymous public object storage
cost_note: API access uses quotas and the user's existing Drive storage; OAuth configuration is required for private files.

name: Google Calendar API
summary: Create, read, and update calendar events and availability.
avoid_when: OAuth consent is outside the workshop scope
a static schedule is enough
cost_note: API usage is quota-limited and generally has no separate charge; user authorization is required for private calendars.

name: YouTube Data API
summary: Search and retrieve YouTube video, channel, and playlist metadata.
avoid_when: you need video transcripts without another permitted source
high-volume searching is required
cost_note: Projects receive a daily quota; search operations consume substantially more quota units than simple reads.

name: Google Books API
summary: Search Google Books and retrieve public book and volume metadata.
avoid_when: you need unrestricted full book text
the project is unrelated to books
cost_note: Public volume searches are available for prototypes; API keys, user data, and usage limits follow the API documentation.

name: Google Apps Script
summary: Hosted JavaScript automation platform integrated with Google Workspace.
avoid_when: you need a conventional backend with predictable long-running execution
cost_note: Apps Script is available with Google accounts and governed by daily and execution quotas.

name: Material Design
summary: Google's design system, guidance, and component ecosystem for consistent interfaces.
avoid_when: the team already has a design system it can implement faster
cost_note: The design guidance and open-source component libraries are free.

name: Google Fonts
summary: Open font catalog with straightforward web embedding and downloadable font files.
avoid_when: the project must avoid third-party font requests and you cannot self-host
cost_note: Fonts in the catalog are open source and free to use under their listed licenses.

name: Supabase
summary: Hosted Postgres platform with authentication, storage, realtime features, and generated APIs.
avoid_when: the workshop must remain entirely in Google's ecosystem
cost_note: A limited free plan is available; check current project pausing and resource limits.

name: Vercel
summary: Web deployment platform with strong integration for Next.js and Git-based workflows.
avoid_when: the project must remain entirely in Google's ecosystem
the intended usage is commercial and exceeds plan terms
cost_note: A free personal plan exists with usage and acceptable-use constraints.

name: OpenStreetMap
summary: Collaborative open geographic database used by many mapping libraries and services.

avoid_when: you expect the public tile servers to act as unrestricted production infrastructure
cost_note: The data is open under its license; public services have usage policies and are not a free unlimited hosting service.
